svg.text: MPx-SQ2-004/005 · Base, spout stem, push-pull sleeve
MPx Squeeze v2 (Mini) · IISc CPDM · preliminary, not for manufacture
1. Cassette pocket Ø45.2 H8 × 2.0 deep; S3 face groove Ø40.5/Ø43.5 × 1.15 in the seat; two tweezer slots 5 wide through the rim at 90°/270°.
2. 8 radial drain ribs 1.2 wide × 0.8 high support the disc; water runs between them to the Ø3 bore.
3. M48×1.0-6g from 21.0 to 29.0; M12×1.0-6g on the stem hub (backflush coupler / UV cap interface).
4. Push-pull: S4 (7 × 1.5) seals the sleeve on the stem; S5 (2.5 × 1.0) on the Ø3.5 pin closes the outlet. Pull 4 mm to open.
5. Cross-port Ø2 at x 44.5 stays inside the sleeve in both positions. Sleeve retained by a 316L wire circlip at the stem root.
